description: Get JSON Schema for the Exeris build-time DomainMetadata AST and sibling records. If 'definition' is omitted, returns the top-level schema envelope, reader requirements (such as Jackson 3 constraints), and definition list. If 'definition' is specified (e.g. 'DomainMetadata', 'FieldMetadata', 'ActionMetadata'), returns the schema definition for that specific record.
name: sdk-get_ast_schema
